_what_this_is: Figures on this page that are not claims about any document, each declared by a person with the sentence it belongs to and the reason. B13 counts them in its report and reports one that no longer matches a sentence as stale, so this file cannot quietly become a filter.
_the_rule: An exclusion says 'this figure is not taken from a source', never 'do not check this figure'. If the sentence changes so that the figure IS a claim about a document, the exclusion stops matching and the check comes back.

exclusions.why: The conventional significance threshold, being explained to the reader. It is not a figure taken out of any study, and the sentence says so: 'an arbitrary line, but a widely used one.'
exclusions.falsifier: the sentence is rewritten to attribute 0.05 to a particular trial's prespecified alpha, at which point it is a claim about a document and this exclusion must go

exclusions.in_sentence: A p-value of 0.05 does not mean
exclusions.why: The same convention, used in the explanation of what a p-value is and is not. No source is being characterised.
exclusions.falsifier: the sentence is rewritten to report 0.05 as a value some study obtained
